drivingQuestion: After which offering does the nazirite shave?
outcomeNote: Mishna records a dispute and an added ruling

segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ תִּגְלַחַת הַטׇּהֳרָה כֵּיצַד? הָיָה מֵבִיא שָׁלֹשׁ בְּהֵמוֹת: חַטָּאת, עוֹלָה, וּשְׁלָמִים. וְשׁוֹחֵט אֶת הַשְּׁלָמִים וּמְגַלֵּחַ עֲלֵיהֶם, דִּבְרֵי רַבִּי יְהוּדָה. רַבִּי אֶלְעָזָר אוֹמֵר: לֹא הָיָה מְגַלֵּחַ אֶלָּא עַל הַחַטָּאת, שֶׁהַחַטָּאת קוֹדֶמֶת בְּכׇל מָקוֹם. וְאִם גִּלַּח עַל אַחַת מִשְּׁלׇשְׁתָּן — יָצָא.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» With regard to a nazirite’s «shaving of purity» after the completion of his term of naziriteship, «how» is it performed? «He would bring three animals:» One for «a sin-offering,» one for «a burnt-offering, and» one for «a peace-offering. And he slaughters the peace-offering and shaves» his hair «after» he slaughters «them.» This is «the statement of Rabbi Yehuda. Rabbi Elazar says: He would shave only after» he slaughtered «the sin-offering, as the sin-offering precedes» the other offerings «in all places,» and therefore he sacrifices the sin-offering first. He shaves his hair after he slaughters this offering. «And if he shaved after» the sacrifice of any «one of the three of them, he has fulfilled» his obligation after the fact.

segments.he: רַבָּן שִׁמְעוֹן בֶּן גַּמְלִיאֵל אוֹמֵר: הֵבִיא שָׁלֹשׁ בְּהֵמוֹת וְלֹא פֵּירֵשׁ, הָרְאוּיָה לְחַטָּאת — תִּקְרַב חַטָּאת, לְעוֹלָה — תִּקְרַב עוֹלָה, לִשְׁלָמִים — תִּקְרַב שְׁלָמִים.
segments.en: «Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel says:» If a nazirite «brought three animals without specifying» which of them was for which offering, the one «that is fit for a sin-offering,» i.e., a female sheep in its first year, «is sacrificed as a sin-offering;» that which is fit «for a burnt-offering,» a male sheep in its first year, «is sacrificed as a burnt-offering;» and that which is fit «for a peace-offering,» a ram, i.e., a male sheep over the age of one year, «is sacrificed as a peace-offering.»

moves.summary: R' Yehuda: bring three animals, shave after slaughtering the peace-offering; post facto any one suffices
R' Elazar: shave only after the sin-offering, which always comes first
RSBG: unspecified animals are each offered according to their fitness
